name: Letux (Spain)
description: White field with a yellow diagonal band edged blue from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Letux (blue and yellow stripes and grapes).
history: Municipal flag of Letux; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: band edged blue from the upper hoist to the lower fly
